title: Infant Transition From Car Bed to Car Safety Seat
brief_summary: This research study has been developed to obtain preliminary information about safe timing of the transition of infants from car beds to car seats, and to find out if initial failure of the car seat challenge is associated with small jaw size or increased respiratory illness.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All infants who visit Children's Hospital Boston, Center for Healthy Infant Lung Development for follow up car seat testing

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: At-risk infants, including all children born at less than 37 weeks gestation and other high risk newborns such as those with a history of breathing problems and/or low tone.
condition: Car Seat Transition for At-risk Infants
